map.📖 查看「检测（年检/维修/充装）服务 使用指南」: View the Detection (Annual Inspection/Repair/Refill) Service User Guide
map.距上次年检月数 =（当前日期 − 上次年检日期）÷（30 × 24 × 3600: Months since the last annual inspection = (current date - last annual inspection date) / (30 x 24 x 3600 x 1000) milliseconds; a portable dry powder extinguisher must have its first hydrostatic test when 5 years old since leaving the factory and every 2 years after that, with a shell scrapping life of 10 years (12 years for carbon dioxide extinguishers); a pressure gauge pointer in the green zone is normal, the yellow zone is overpressure, and the red zone is insufficient pressure needing a refill; once the scrapping life is reached or the shell is corroded through, it is judged as fail and must be replaced.
map.灭火器年检充装评估（灭火器状态检测）: Extinguisher annual inspection and refill assessment (extinguisher condition check)
map.灭火器月度/年度巡检中，按类型（CO₂/干粉/泡沫/水基）核对年检期限与筒体状况: In the monthly/annual patrol of extinguishers, the annual inspection deadline and shell condition are checked by type (CO2 / dry powder / foam / water-based).
map.到期、锈蚀、喷管破损、铅封缺失、标识不清等逐项加扣，量化合格/需维护/需充装更换: Overdue, corrosion, hose breakage, missing seal and unclear label are deducted item by item, quantifying pass / needs maintenance / needs refill and replacement.
map.压力不足是关键红线，必须送检充装。: Insufficient pressure is the key red line and must be sent for testing and refilling.
map.算例：水基灭火器、距年检 6 个月、压力正常、无外观问题: Worked example: water-based extinguisher, 6 months since annual inspection, pressure normal, no exterior issues
map.水基最大年检周期 12 个月，6 个月未超期也不临近（>10 个月才提示临近），: The maximum annual inspection period for water-based is 12 months, so 6 months is neither overdue nor near expiry (only >10 months triggers the near-expiry notice), pressure scores 0 and nothing is ticked -> score = 0 -> 'pass'; it can be used normally within its validity period.
map.超期（按类型 12/12/24/12 月）加 3 分并提示超期月数；临近到期加: Overdue (12/12/24/12 months by type) adds 3 points and reports the overdue months; near expiry adds 1 point; corrosion or breakage adds +2 each; missing seal or unclear label adds +1 each; the pressure value is counted directly. 0 points pass, <=3 needs maintenance, >3 needs refilling/replacement.
map.不同类型灭火器的年检周期一样吗？: Is the annual inspection period the same for all extinguisher types?
map.不一样。本工具取 CO₂/干粉 12 个月、泡沫 24 个月、水基 12 个月（: No. This tool uses 12 months for CO2/dry powder, 24 months for foam and 12 months for water-based (common figures, subject to the latest standard). Overdue deducts points and reports the overdue months.
map.压力不足为什么必须充装？: Why must insufficient pressure be refilled?
map.压力不足意味着内压低于工作范围，喷射距离与灭火能力不达标，存在关键时刻失效风险，: Insufficient pressure means the internal pressure is below the working range, the spray distance and extinguishing capacity do not meet the standard, and there is a risk of failure at a critical moment; this is a hard red line and must be sent for testing and refilling or replacement, never used while faulty.
